Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental physics error by incorrectly comparing masses and misinterpreting negative exponents, asserting that 9.11×10^-31 kg (electron) is greater than 1.67×10^-27 kg (proton) because 31 > 27. This led to the incorrect conclusion that losing a proton would result in the least mass loss, instead of the correct answer that losing an electron would.
